certificate.finite_formula: F_fin=h^(-k)sum_r omega^r[zeta(k,(delta+r)/h)-zeta(k,(delta+r)/h+C)] for k>1, with the zeta difference replaced by psi((delta+r)/h+C)-psi((delta+r)/h) for k=1
certificate.infinite_formula: F_inf=h^(-k)sum_r omega^r zeta(k,(delta+r)/h) for k>1; F_inf=-h^(-1)sum_r omega^r psi((delta+r)/h) for k=1
